WITH route AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-118.336238 45.899365, -118.336015 45.899471, -118.335481 45.899546, -118.334629 45.899586, -118.333434 45.899564)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg
  FROM route r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.seg_len_m,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p1) AS z1,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p2) AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip dc
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM slopes
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DEGREES(ATAN(g)) AS slope_degrees
FROM avg_grade;

WITH road_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-118.336238 45.899365, -118.336015 45.899471, -118.335481 45.899546, -118.334629 45.899586, -118.333434 45.899564)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
raster_clip AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      1,
      (SELECT geom FROM road_geom),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    r.rast,
    (SELECT geom FROM road_geom)
  )
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM raster_clip
)
SELECT
  ST_Stats(slope_rast, 1, TRUE).mean AS avg_slope_degrees
FROM slope_raster s;
